In order to align the Global Data Management responsibilities for Contracts 
and Facilities with the overall Operations support for Brian Redmond's Asset 
area, the Global Contracts and Global Facilities functions for Assets have 
been transferred to Steve Venturatos within Brenda Herod's Gas Assets 
Operations organization.   All contract and facility requests for the Enron 
companies listed below should be directed to Steve.

HPL Companies
 Houston Pipe Line
 Mid Texas Pipeline
 Enron Field Services
 HPL Compression Company
 HPL Resources

LRC Companies
 Enron Storage Company
 Enron Storage Co., LLC
 Louisiana Resources Company
 Louisiana Gas Pipeline Company Limited Partnership
 Louisiana Resources Pipeline Company Limited Partnership

Denver Companies
 Fort Union LLC
 Enron Midstream Services Powder River
 Lost Creek

Project Hurricane
 Bridgeline Holding L.P.
 Bridgeline Gas Distribution LLC
 Bridgeline Gas Marketing LLC


Global requests for Enron North America and Offsystem pipelines will continue 
to be handled in my area by Connie Sutton.  Responsibility for Global 
Counterparty setups and updates remains centralized in my organization headed 
by Mary Gosnell. 

If I have missed someone in the distribution, please forward.
